notes: Context: mid-market product analytics company building in-app assistant + document search. Currently on BlueModelCloud for generation + reranking. Evaluating Redwood Hosted -> Dedicated migration path. POC notes: used a compatibility shim (proxy) to translate their existing BlueModel API calls to Redwood endpoints so product code change was minimal. Good: SDK parity makes integration fast; streaming and function-calling worked out of the box. Issues: 'prompt parity' gaps — tokenization differences and stop-token handling changed output formatting; reranking utility metric drift (~3-5% on tail queries) observed in evaluation harness. Quote from PM: "We need exact parity on critical queries or we risk regression in search UX." SE action: run focused prompt tweaks + soft-prompt templates and compare quantized model variants. Performance targets: p95 latency <= 350ms for chat flows, sustained throughput ~300 qps for embeddings/rerank, acceptable cost uplift <= 15% if quality improves. Security: require SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS integration and confirmation of data residency for EU customers. Procurement: flagged pricing as blocker, asked for 12-month committed price and overage terms. Next steps: finish parity eval (100k queries), deliver dedicated pricing workbook, schedule CISO/legal call week of 2025-03-10, run Dedicated POC with canary routing for 10% production traffic.
